name: Aforgomon's Blade
text: Uses (3 Charges) [action] Fight You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, ou may spend 1 charge and exhaust Aforgomon's Blade to gain 1 action and give the attacked enemy -1 fight and -1 evade until the end of the round.

name: Gaze of Aforgomon
text: Revelation - Put Gaze of Aforgomon into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you have taken at least 4 actions this turn: Place 1 resource on Gaze of Aforgomon, as an offering. [action][action]: Place 1 resource on Gaze of Aforgomon, as an offering. Forced - At the end of the game, if Gaze of Aforgomon has fewer than 4 offerings on it: You suffer 1 physical trauma.

back_flavor: You've found your way back to Arkham... you think. The city before you is unfamiliar to you, an oppressive vista of smoke and steel dotted with colored lights.
name: A Disquieting Future
flavor: The streets are busy and garishly lit. Strange devices flit to and fro, as mechanical eyes follow your every move.
text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [int](3). If you succeed, heal 1 damage or 1 horror. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror.

text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [int](3). If you succeed, draw a card. If you fail, take 1 horror and choose and discard a card from your hand.

back_flavor: A muddy battlefield is strung with barbed wire and gun emplacements. A war is being waged here - one grand enough to rival the Great War whose scars still sit upon the world.
name: A World at War
text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, place 1 of your clues on this location.

back_flavor: A muddy battlefield is strung with barbed wire and gun emplacements. A war is being waged here - one grand enough to rival the Great War whose scars still sit upon the world.
name: A World at War
text: Forced - At the end of your turn, if there is no copy of Aerial Bombardment attached to A World at War: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Aerial Bombardment and draw it. Do not resolve its forced ability this turn.

back_flavor: Before you lies one possible future - a dry, barren Earth, utterly devoid of life.
name: An Earth Long Dead
flavor: The dry air is all too thin. You gulp it in desperately, but grow woozy at the lack of oxygen.
text: Forced - After you enter this location: Take 1 damage and 1 horror.

text: Forced - After you enter this location: Lose 1 action.

back_flavor: It's the place you know, but not as you know it. In the midst of witch-hunting hysteria, the old city is gripped by paranoid suspicion.
name: Arkham, Massachusetts
flavor: The streets are cold and empty. Suspicious faces peer out of windows as you pass.
text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, during the next upkeep phase, your exhausted cards cannot ready.

text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.

back_flavor: From the fact that the pyramids on the horizon seem to still be under construction, you surmise that you're still far from your own time.
name: Banks of the Nile
flavor: The desert sun beats down on you, as the wind whips sand into your eyes. Looks like a storm is brewing...
text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Sandstorm and draw it.

back_flavor: You find yourself surrounded by hot, dense jungle. Small lizards abound, and in the far distance you can hear the crashing of something much, much larger...
name: Millions of Years Ago
text: Enemies at Millions of Years Ago get +1 fight and -1 evade. Forced - At the end of your turn, if there are no [[Dinosaur]] enemies at this location: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Dinosaur]] enemy and spawn it at this location, exhausted. Shuffle the encounter deck.

back_flavor: You find yourself surrounded by hot, dense jungle. Small lizards abound, and in the far distance you can hear the crashing of something much, much larger...
name: Millions of Years Ago
flavor: You're learning an awful lot about dinosaurs. Unfortunately, they're also learning rather a lot about you.
text: Enemies at Millions of Years Ago get +1 fight and -1 evade. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [combat] (3). If you fail, take X damage, where X is the number of clues you discovered this turn (min 1).

back_flavor: You stand in the beating heart of an organism spanning half the world. Beasts don't get much more dangerous.
name: Heart of an Empire
flavor: You stand in the beating heart of an organism spanning half the world. Beasts don't get much more dangerous.
text: Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, move to a random other [[Adrift]] location. Do not resolve any forced abilities on that location that would trigger at the end of your turn.

back_flavor: A strange metallic voice drifts from the walls: "Welcome aboard the Tatterdemalion. The current star date is March 28, 2147." A huge blue orb hangs outside the window, framed by the blackness of space - a planet, but not Earth.
name: The Tatterdemalion
text: [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at this location: Defeat that enemy. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, discard a random card from your hand.

back_flavor: A strange metallic voice drifts from the walls: "Welcome aboard the Tatterdemalion. The current star date is March 28, 2147." A huge blue orb hangs outside the window, framed by the blackness of space - a planet, but not Earth.
name: The Tatterdemalion
text: [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at this location: Defeat that enemy. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either discard an asset you control, or take 1 horror for each point you failed by.

name: Time Runs Backwards
text: Revelation - Shuffle your hand into your deck. If at least 3 cards are shuffled in this way, draw a card and add a non-exceptional card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Curse of a Thousand Winters
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, put Curse of a Thousand Winters into play in your threat area with X resources on it, where X is the amount you failed by. Forced - At the start of your turn: Lose 1 action. Remove 1 resource from Curse of a Thousand Winters. Then if there are no resources on Curse of a Thousand Winters, discard it.

name: Monastic Training
text: While Monastic Training is in your discard pile, when you reveal a [skull] token during a skill test, after this test resolves you may discard a card to add Monastic Training to your hand.

name: Chronal Atlas
text: Uses (3 secrets) You get +1 [intellect]. [react] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Chronal Atlas and spend 1 secret: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 1 of these tokens to resolve, and seal the other here. Forced - At the end of the round: Return any tokens sealed on Chronal Atlas to the chaos bag.

name: Ionian Pendant
text: [react] When you would perform a skill test during a revelation effect, exhaust Ionian Pendant and place 1 horror on it: You may use [combat] in place of the listed skill for that test.

name: Agency Strike Team
text: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Either deal 3 damage to each enemy at the chosen location, or discover 3 clues at the chosen location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Wings of Damakairon
text:
Fast. 
You get +1 [agility]. 
[fast] Exhaust Wings of Damakairon: Your location gets -2 shoud for this skill test. You may not use this ability during your turn.

name: Forestall Fate
text:
Fast. 
Uses (4 charges). 
[fast] Ekhaust Forestall Fate, spend 1 charge: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, gain an action. If a [elder_thing] or [autofail] token is revealed during this skill test, take 2 horror or lose an action.

name: Fulcrum of Possibility
text: [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either move to any other location, or move another investigator to this location.
back_text: Revelation - Put Fulcrum of Possibility into play. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are any clues on this location: In player order, each investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck.

name: Fulcrum of Possibility
text: [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either move to any other location, or move another investigator to this location.

name: The Myriad
text: Spawn - The Present. Massive. Swarming 2[per_investigator]. Forced - When The Myriad attacks during the enemy phase: Resolve its attack against one investigator at its location (instead of against each investigator). Attacks from copies of The Myriad must be split as evenly as possible between each investigator at its location.

name: Days That Never Were
text: [action] Take 1 mental trauma and exile a card in your hand of level 1 or higher: Search your collection for a non-exceptional player card of level at most X, where X is the level of the exiled card. Add that card to your hand. (Limit once per game.)
back_text: Revelation - Put Days That Never Were into play. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are any clues on this location: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Each investigator at this location must either take 2 direct horror or exile a card in their hand of level 1 or higher.

name: Days That Never Were
text: [action] Take 1 mental trauma and exile a card in your hand of level 1 or higher: Search your collection for a non-exceptional player card of level at most X, where X is the level of the exiled card. Add that card to your hand. (Limit once per game.)
back_text: Revelation - The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Put this card into play in your threat area. - Remove this card from the game. Place 2 doom on the current agenda. This effect may cause the current agenda to advance. Your existence is waning. Forced - At the end of your turn: Exile the top 1[per_investigator] cards of your deck. Take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.

name: Secrets Long Forgotten
text: Forced - After you successfully investigate Secrets Long Forgotten: Either draw a card, or take 1 horror and search your collection for a level 0 skill card, adding that card to your hand.

name: Eternity's Sentinel
subname: He's Been Waiting For So Long
text: Spawn - Furthest location from all investigators. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. If the investigators slew their strange observer, Eternity's Sentinel gets +2 fight, +1 damage and +1 horror.

name: Secrets Long Forgotten
text: Forced - After you successfully investigate Secrets Long Forgotten: Either draw a card, or take 1 horror and search your collection for a level 0 skill card, adding that card to your hand.

name: Truth
text: Spawn - The Past. Alert. Hunter. Forced - After Truth attacks you: Search the collection for a random basic [[Madness]] weakness and draw it. Place 1 doom on the current agenda.

name: Today, a Thousand Times
text: Forced - After a skill test is performed at this location: Perform that test again. (Limit once per phase.)
back_text: Chronos gazes upon the timelines with his three eyes. With the knowledge he has, the multitude of alternate existences he sees and manipulates, how can you possibly hope to stop him? You can't. You just can't. Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Remove A Thousand Paths to Victory from the game.

name: Today, a Thousand Times
text: Forced - After a skill test is performed at this location: Perform that test again. (Limit once per phase.)
back_text: Chronos gazes upon the timelines with his three eyes. From each, he takes note of anomalies, potential threats, aberrations he might be able to use. Now, he seeks these out, plucking them from their realities and launching them at you. In player order, each investigator draws the top three cards of the encounter deck, one at a time. Remove A Thousand Avenues of Attack from the game.

name: What Could Be
text: [action]: Until the end of the round, What Could Be is connected to each other location, and vice versa. Investigators at any location can activate this ability.
back_text: In countless times and places, a myriad of cruel injustices have befell kings and paupers, the kind and the cruel, rogues and saints and vagabonds. Now, they are yours. The lead investigator draws the top 2[per_investigator] cards of the encounter deck, one at a time. If they are defeated by a card drawn this way, the new lead investigator draws the remainder of these cards. Remove Tide of Possibility from the game.

name: What Could Be
text: [action]: Until the end of the round, What Could Be is connected to each other location, and vice versa. Investigators at any location can activate this ability.
back_text: Revelation - The investigator with the highest total base [combat] and [agility] puts this card into play in their threat area. Set the base value of your [combat] and [agility] to 1. Forced - At the start of the investigator phase: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy engaged with you. [action]: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Remove Aged a Thousand Years from the game.

name: What Could Never Be
text: This location cannot be investigated.
back_text: You are being changed. Your timeline is being unwritten. Your ancestry, your history, the things that make you, you. Gone. Each investigator tests [willpower] (3), [intellect] (3), [combat] (3) and [agility] (3), in any order. If "your existence is waning", each of these tests gets +1 difficulty for you. Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror for each of these tests that they fail. Each investigator that fails at least three of these tests is killed. Remove Erasure from the game.

name: What Could Never Be
text: This location cannot be investigated.
back_text: The wards you've built are strong, but Aforgomon's power knows no earthly bounds. It attacks your wards from the inside, dismantling the protection you've laid over your reality. One investigator tests [willpower] (5). One investigator tests [intellect] (5). One investigator tests [willpower]+[intellect] (8). For each of these tests that is failed, the performing investigator must choose a different option: - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This can cause the current agenda to advance. - Choose a random warded location in play, and place it beneath the agenda deck. - The performing investigator takes 6 horror. Remove Shattering Paradox from the game.

name: Dawn of the Universe
text: [reaction] After you enter Dawn of the Universe: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a card and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at Dawn of the Universe: Take 1 damage and 1 physical trauma. Place 1 clue on Dawn of the Universe.
back_text: Revelation - Put Dawn of the Universe into play. Forced - After you enter Dawn of the Universe: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a weakness and draw it. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are any clues on this location: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Each investigator at this location must move to a connecting location.

name: Dawn of the Universe
text: [reaction] After you enter Dawn of the Universe: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a card and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at Dawn of the Universe: Take 1 damage and 1 physical trauma. Place 1 clue on Dawn of the Universe.
back_text: Revelation - Put Dawn of the Universe into play. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Dawn of the Universe: Return an asset you control to your hand. If that asset has uses, take X damage or X horror, where X is the difference between the listed number of uses and the number of uses remaining on the card. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are any clues on this location: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.

name: The End of All Things
text:
As an additional cost to move to The End of All Things, exile a non-weakness asset you control.
[action] Exile a non-weakness asset you control: Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per round.)
back_text: At the end of the universe is nothing, an endless, bitter blackness that consumes everything it touches. Even that, as terrible as it began, bears the marks of Aforgomon's interference, as it twists and wends towards you, seeking your end at the dark god's behest. Each investigator tests [combat] (4). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage for each point they failed by. Each investigator tests [willpower] (4). Each investigator who fails takes 1 horror for each point they failed by. Each investigator whose "existence is waning" tests [agility] (4). Each investigator who fails chooses and exiles a card from their hand for each point they failed by. Remove Oblivion Beckons from the game.

name: The End of All Things
text:
As an additional cost to move to The End of All Things, exile a non-weakness asset you control.
[action] Exile a non-weakness asset you control: Gain 2 clues from the token pool. (Limit once per round.)

name: Oblivion
text: Spawn - The Future. Hunter. Massive. Oblivion cannot be defeated. For each 1[per_investigator] damage on Oblivion, it gets -1 damage value and -1 horror value. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: If Oblivion is ready, it heals 1[per_investigator] damage. Otherwise, ready Oblivion.

name: Unstable Energies
text: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +2 damage. Forced - If Unstable Energies is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and take 1 damage.
